rule: Candidates: Wikidata items that are a car/truck/bus/motorcycle/scooter/moped/ATV/vehicle model (or model series), or that are typed car, van, bus, truck, motorcycle, scooter or pickup (P31/P279) and have a manufacturer (P176) or brand (P1716). Generations (P179 part of the series, P279 subclass of, or names such as 'Golf Mk8', 'Mégane IV', 'Fiat Panda (2003)', 'Passat B8', 'W213') are folded into one model per make + name + type; body variants (estate, sedan, 3-door...) and performance trims (GTI, RS, N, AMG...) fold into their model. Excluded: concept cars, prototypes, race and rally cars, military, police and emergency vehicles, toys, scale models and kits, trolleybuses, trams, motorhomes, and items named only by a chassis code. Kept when Wikidata shows production in or after 2000: a start date (P580, P571, P2031, P729, P5204, P577) or end date (P582, P2032, P730) of 2000 or later on the model or one of its generations, or such a year range in an item description in any language. A model started before 2000 with no end date is kept only with evidence it was still made (wording such as 'since 1997' or '1997-present', a non-heritage official website P856, or a model year of 2000+ in its image or Commons category). Undated models are kept only when their make was not dissolved and there is evidence: a year of 2000+ in the image file name, Commons category or description (and no pre-2000 year), a predecessor (P155) built after 2000, an official website, a crossover/electric/hybrid class, or (cars and vans only) an item created in 2019 or later with no successor from a make with at least 3 models active after 2010. Undated models whose successor started before 2000, or that show only pre-2000 years, are dropped. A hand-checked list of current European-market models that Wikidata leaves undated is kept explicitly, and must-have models missing from Wikidata are added with source 'manual'. from = earliest production start among the generations made in or after 2000 (omitted when unknown); to = latest production end, null when still made or unknown.
